news.title: HDFCAMC: Dividend Plans And Board Actions Will Shape Measured Future Outlook
news.body: Analysts have raised their fair value estimate for HDFC Asset Management slightly to ₹3,029.35 from ₹3,027.50, reflecting updated views on revenue growth expectations, profit margins and a modestly lower assumed future P/E multiple. What's in the News The board has recommended a final dividend of ₹54 per equity share of face value ₹5 for the year ended March 31, 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting (Key Developments).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹66.50 (up from ₹57.58 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹46.2b (up 14% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹28.6b (up 16% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 62% (up from 61% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 2.6%. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 16% growth forecast for the Capital Markets industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 23% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 47% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited Proposes Final Dividend for the Financial Year Ended March 31, 2026
news.body: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited announced at the board meeting held on April 16, 2026, Recommended a final Dividend of INR 54/- (Rupees Fifty Four only) per equity share of INR 5/- each of the Company, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, subject To Approve the shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting. The final dividend, if approved by the shareholders, will be remitted within the applicable regulatory timelines after the Annual General Meeting.

news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹17.97 (up from ₹15.01 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹12.3b (up 20% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹7.69b (up 20% from 3Q 2025).
